agentEngineering.title: Agent
agentEngineering.subtitle: The three disciplines behind every production agent I ship. A model is not a product. The harness, the loop, and the graph around it are.

harness.title: Harness Engineering
harness.desc: The safety net around the model: tools, memory, permissions, observability. The harness decides what an agent can see, touch, and remember.
harness.callout: Agent forgot what it did 5 steps ago? Deleted the wrong file? That's not a model failure. It's a harness problem.

loop.title: Loop Engineering
loop.desc: How the agent evaluates its own work and gets better at the job: tests, evals, and verification wired into every iteration.
loop.callout: Evidence over confidence. A coding agent stops when the tests pass, not when it feels done.

graph.title: Graph Engineering
graph.desc: Orchestration of the full workflow (branching, approvals, retries, parallel tasks) that turns a single agent into a dependable system.
graph.callout: One agent is a demo. A graph with retries, approval gates, and parallel branches is a product.

agentEngineering.footer: harness × loop × graph: the framework I apply to every agent build
